text:
Silver Price in 1979
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1979, the LBMA silver price rose 379.8% between 1979-01-31 ($6.71) and 1979-12-31 ($32.20). The highest sampled price was $32.20 in December and the lowest was $6.71 in January. The mean of these observations was $12.52. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 1979:
Surging inflation, the Iranian Revolution and the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan sent precious metals sharply higher.
